Kayak Weight Capacity - The maximum weight capacity for these tandem ( 2 people ) car kayaks is 410 pounds No single person can weigh more than 225. These kayak will not float you if you exceed the weight limit. We also offer paddle boards and solo (non clear) kayaks for this adventure. If someone in your group does not fit the weight capacity, no worries. We offer an option for non clear solo sit on top kayaks with a weight capacity of 300 pounds and non clear sit on top tandem kayaks with a weight capacity of 500 pounds, and paddle boards 250 pounds.le

blurb:
Our kayak tours are incredible. Manatees, wild monkeys & beautiful water birds can all be seen here. With 23 years of experience & a UF master naturalist, our owner has organized a proffesiomal, knowledgeeable team so you can rest assured that you will have a safe and informative experience. 

Imerse yourself in the breathtaking beauty of Silver Springs, Florida’s premier kayaking destination. Our clear kayak guided tours offer an amazing adventure, allowing you to explore the crystal clear waters while spotting incredible wildlife.

You will have the chance to see manatees, wild monkeys, & stunning water birds in their natural habitat. As you paddle through this historic waterway, you’ll also discover fascinating underwater artifacts—including sunken ships, statues, and remnants from famous movies filmed here!

Along the way, your guide will entertain you with captivating stories about Florida’s first-ever tourist attraction.

Join us for this unforgettable adventure today!
